# Term Sheet

## Proposed Convertible Loan Investment in Fixture Robotics AG

Draft of 15 July 2026 — non-binding except as stated under "Binding
Provisions". Not signed.

This term sheet summarizes the principal terms of a proposed convertible loan
investment (the "CLA Round") in Fixture Robotics AG, Teststrasse 1, 8000
Zurich, Switzerland (the "Borrower"). It is prepared on the basis of the SECA
CLA Model Documentation (short form) of February 2025.

| Term | Content |
|---|---|
| Borrower | Fixture Robotics AG, Zurich (CHE-999.999.999). |
| Type of Investment | Subordinated, unsecured loans convertible into shares of the Borrower upon the triggering events set out below (the "Loans"). |
| Investment Amount | Up to an aggregate amount of CHF 500,000, with a minimum aggregate amount of CHF 300,000 for the first closing (the "Investment Amount"). |
| Investors | CHF 150,000 from Fixture Angels, Zug (the "Lead Investor"). Additional investors may, with the consent of the Borrower and the Lead Investor, accede to this Term Sheet by countersigning an accession declaration (together with the Lead Investor the "Investors"). The Investment Amount may be reduced to the extent existing shareholders of the Borrower exercise their pre-emption rights. |
| Interest Rate | 4% per annum, accruing, calculated on the actual number of days elapsed over a 365-day year, not compounded. |
| Term | The Loans shall mature 24 months after the first closing, expected on 15 August 2026, i.e. on 15 August 2028 (the "Maturity Date"). On the Maturity Date any Loan not converted shall be repaid together with accrued interest. |
| Qualified Equity Financing Round | The next share capital increase of the Borrower with gross proceeds of at least CHF 3,000,000 (including the converted Loans) at a price per share fixed by bona fide third-party investors. |
| Mandatory Conversion | Upon the closing of the Qualified Equity Financing Round, the outstanding loan balance including accrued interest converts into the same class of shares issued in that round (expected: preferred A shares), at the lower of (i) the round price less a discount of 20% and (ii) the price per share derived from a pre-money valuation of CHF 12,000,000 (the "Valuation Cap"). |
| Voluntary Conversion | If an equity financing round closes that does not qualify, each Investor may elect to convert its Loan at the terms of that round, applying the same discount and Valuation Cap. |
| Conversion Shares | The conversion shares are issued out of the conditional share capital of the Borrower or, failing that, by way of an ordinary capital increase to which the existing shareholders have consented in advance. |
| Shareholders' Agreement | Upon conversion the Investors accede to the shareholders' agreement of the Borrower then in force. |
| Subordination | The Loans, including accrued interest, are subordinated within the meaning of art. 725b para. 4 no. 1 CO to all other claims against the Borrower. |
| Investor Majority | Amendments, waivers and extensions of the Maturity Date require the consent of Investors holding at least two thirds of the aggregate principal amount of the Loans. |
| Confidentiality | The terms of this Term Sheet are confidential. **Binding.** |
| Documentation | The investment shall be made under convertible loan agreements based on the SECA CLA Model Documentation (short form), drafted by Fixture Legal AG, Zurich, as counsel to the Borrower. |
| Legal Fees and Expenses | Each party bears its own costs and expenses in connection with the CLA Round. **Binding.** |
| Exclusivity | Until 30 September 2026 the Borrower shall not solicit or negotiate any other convertible loan financing. **Binding.** |
| Applicable Law and Jurisdiction | Swiss law; courts of Zurich. **Binding.** |
| Binding Provisions | Only the sections marked "Binding" (Confidentiality, Legal Fees and Expenses, Exclusivity, Applicable Law and Jurisdiction) are legally binding. All other terms are subject to the definitive agreements. |

Zurich, 15 July 2026

For the Borrower: Fixture Robotics AG *(unsigned)*

For the Lead Investor: Fixture Angels *(unsigned)*
